plan.title: eRFX RFQ invite mapped and named vendors

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the project with an RFQ stage only.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields required for publishing.
Add every vendor mapped to the product using the product's own invitation action.
Add the specifically named Vendor C to the participant set.
Publish the RFQ project with its configured participants.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants tab to inspect the final participant list.
Verify that Vendor C is present and selected on the published stage.
Confirm that the published stage contains participants.
